figures.description: Mean accepted voltage drop by N and module, separately for zero and recorded load.

semantics.measurement: 1000*(source main V - accepted module main V), sequential DMM readings.
semantics.estimator: Equal-weight arithmetic mean within each recorded load, N and physical module.
semantics.spread: Sample SD (ddof=1) across distinct combinations at N=2,3. No SD at N=1,4.
semantics.independence: One observation per exact combination/load; shared modules and sources, not independent repeat trials.
semantics.correction: ZERO N3 M0 includes 35 mV from separate 3.241 V M0 retest with retained user-confirmed source 3.276 V. Original 52 mV contact-fault difference is preserved in source event and original report, outside accepted means.
semantics.loading: MAX is the recorded load label; mass/area/distribution are not harmonised.
semantics.jitter: Deterministic horizontal separation only; all measured y values unchanged.
semantics.report: Supplementary figures only; published main 2.3 and existing figures unchanged.
